method: Whole-file manual reading; ExplorerWatcher split into consecutive chunks through final braces after initial combined output truncation. Git blob identity verified. No Windows hooks executed.
findings: HookManager async-void dispatch has no encompassing error handler; undefined profile enum values reach throwing default. Dispose does not detach profile-manager or session-ending subscriptions or cancel pending actions.

ExplorerWatcher singleton flag is unsynchronized and set before constructor initialization succeeds. Dispose has no idempotence/initialization guard; shell fields may still be null before first timer initialization. Explorer check timer is not explicitly disposed by Dispose.

Shell dictionary uses selective locks, with unlocked enumeration, count and key updates on asynchronous paths. Source does not establish thread-safe access across timer, COM callbacks, scheduler and consumers.

Five-second navigation timeout releases semaphore but does not detach NavigateComplete2 handler or cancel navigation; late callback can still select items. Queued STA tasks and delayed continuations have no lifecycle cancellation.

RequestToOpenNewTab zero-handle branch passes lockToOpenWindows as second positional argument to OpenNewWindowWithSelection, where it binds duplicate rather than lockToOpenWindows. Caller intent to bypass semaphore is not forwarded by this branch.
Automatic conversion starts destination-tab task without awaiting success, then quits source window. Closed-record reopen removes history before successful navigation; failure lacks rollback.

GetWindows and persistence group by default string equality of Location rather than shell equivalence or content identity; last 100 persisted entries limit storage only, while live closed-window history grows without an explicit cap.
Recently-closed age subtracts signed Environment.TickCount from promoted stored value; wrap handling is not explicit. A stale record encountered first terminates backward search.

Cleanup releases COM objects before draining STA scheduler and lacks try/finally around the complete resource sequence; an exception can skip remaining cleanup. Subscription failure removes dictionary entry without explicit matching detach/release in that catch.
limits: Static findings, not reproduced Windows race/crash claims. Original application runtime, COM apartment correctness and actual deadlock reachability remain unqualified.
No implementation adopted from tab-management repository; file-content dedup remains separate. Fully reviewed repository count148/500; native pHash investigation deferred.
